verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at kb.pigment.com that indexes the knowledge base, and per-page markdown docs (.md) with a 'Documentation Index' header aimed at agents. The marketing site also serves its own llms.txt (www.pigment.com/llms.txt), so an agent can be pointed at either. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and any first-party guidance explaining how to use the agent-oriented docs.
